items.title: Liverpool takeover Q&A: What do we know about Bezos' consortium?
items.description: Liverpool's owners Fenway Sports Group have sold a stake in Liverpool Football Club to a consortium including Amazon founder Jeff Bezos.

items.title: Gay bags pair in Test warm-up as Pakistan captain Babar suffers injury scare
items.description: England opener Emilio Gay bagged a pair and Pakistan captain Babar Azam suffered an injury scare on an eventful second day of the Test match-warm up in Beckenham.

items.title: Teenage British cyclist Tarling dies after accident during Volta a Portugal
items.description: British cyclist Finlay Tarling, 19, has died after a serious accident during the eighth stage of the Volta a Portugal road race.

items.title: All done deals in August 2026
items.description: Check out the significant signings and departures in the Premier League, Scottish Premiership, EFL and Women's Super League.

items.title: Man City miss Chelsea's deadline to bid for Fernandez
items.description: The 5pm Friday deadline set by Chelsea for Man City to make their bid for Enzo Fernandez has passed with no offer made for the midfielder.

items.title: RFU postpones start of competitive community rugby season in England
items.description: The RFU has postponed the start of the competitive community game season until the week commencing Monday September 21 due to "concerns about player welfare and pitch conditions".

items.title: SunRisers into Hundred women's final with tense win over Brave
items.description: SunRisers Leeds booked a meeting with Trent Rockets in The Hundred women's final after a tense five-wicket win over Southern Brave in the eliminator at The Kia Oval.

items.title: FSG sell minority stake in Liverpool to Bezos-backed consortium
items.description: Liverpool's owners have agreed to sell around a third of the club to a consortium including Amazon founder Jeff Bezos.

items.title: Burnley drop shirt sponsor after 42 days
items.description: Burnley drop their shirt sponsor just two days before their opening Championship match against West Ham - and only 42 days after signing the deal.

items.title: Hull City latest: Club confirm forward exit
Rangers boss McInnes 'doing his best', says Halliday
items.description: "Derek McInnes is doing the best that he possibly can with what's at his disposal to try and get results."

items.title: Chelsea say no Fernandez move as deadline passes - but is it really over?
items.description: Chelsea's deadline for clubs to bid £120m for midfielder Enzo Fernandez has passed - and they now expect the Argentine to stay at the club this season.
